verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS platform that also ships a CLI and MCP servers, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a way to disable telemetry, analytics, or usage tracking in the Ramp web app, the CLI, or the MCP servers. OAuth scopes, role restrictions and audit logs are related access controls, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
